name: TOOL - Get Products (Portfolio Example - Not Retested)

parameters.query:
SELECT
    id,
    name,
    description,
    price,
    stock
FROM products
WHERE is_active = TRUE
  AND stock > 0
  AND (
      NULLIF(TRIM($1::TEXT), '') IS NULL
      OR name ILIKE '%' || TRIM($1::TEXT) || '%'
      OR description ILIKE '%' || TRIM($1::TEXT) || '%'
  )
  AND (
      $2::NUMERIC IS NULL
      OR price <= $2::NUMERIC
  )
ORDER BY name
LIMIT 10;
